verses.gurmukhi: ਖੁਲੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਭਲੋ ਹੈ ਸੀਚਾਨੋ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਜੀਵ ਘਾਤ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: khule se ba(n)dhan bikhai bhalo hai seechaano jaa te jeev ghaat karai na bikaar hoi aaviee ||

en.bdb: A falcon is better in captivity as it would keep him away from killing other birds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੁਲੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਚਕਈ ਭਲੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰੇਖ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: khule se ba(n)dhan bikhai chakiee bhalee jaa te raam rekh meT nis pria sa(n)g paaviee ||

en.bdb: A red-legged partridge (Chakvi) is better in captivity that enables her meet her partner at night contrary to the curse of Sri Ram Chander.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੁਲੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਭਲੋ ਹੈ ਸੂਆ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: khule se ba(n)dhan bikhai bhalo hai sooaa prasidh sun upadhes raam naam liv laaviee ||

en.bdb: A parrot is better in cage where he can receive sermons from his master and repeat the name of the Lord perpetually.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ ਸੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਭਲੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਈ ॥੧੫੪॥
verses.translit_en: mokh padhavee sai taise maanas janam bhalo gurmukh hoi saadh sa(n)g prabh dhiaaviee ||154||

en.bdb: Similarly being born in a human body is better since it helps an individual to be an obedient slave of the True Guru and remembers the Lord in the holy company of Lord's beloveds rather than acquiring emancipation outwardly. (154)
